## Checklist

- [ ] I separated established evidence from project hypothesis.
- [ ] I considered Sybil / identity-reset effects where relevant.
- [ ] I considered collusion where relevant.
- [ ] I considered monitor / governance capture where relevant.
- [ ] I avoided implying that reputation proves alignment.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI or autonomous-agent involvement.
- [ ] I reviewed generated claims, citations, code, and licensing.
- [ ] This change contains no credentials, personal data, or private prompts.
- [ ] I identified changes to dependencies, workflows, permissions, authentication, scoring, or governance.
- [ ] I did not rely on passing automation as approval to merge.
